note: DRAFT. Not a preregistration and not executed. Outstanding choices (search universe, recruitment, adjudication procedure, instrument digests) are unresolved. Becomes registrable only when freeze F1 (selection rules, before content screening) and freeze F2 (case packets, evaluator key, instrument digests, coding rubric, before participant exposure) both exist, each recorded in a subsequent registration receipt rather than in the frozen file itself.
what_is_tested: whether the contract helps practitioners make appropriate decisions, including the decision not to map

battery.required_behavior: recognize applicability; compare plausible explanations; select a bounded action or a discriminating probe
battery.observable_failure: blanket refusal; unsupported certainty; a map disconnected from any available decision
battery.selection_rule: first candidate satisfying contract preconditions P1-P4 under the frozen ordering

battery.required_behavior: identify the unmet population requirement; stop mapping or request the specific missing evidence
battery.observable_failure: manufacture a recurring pattern from insufficient history
battery.selection_rule: own declared criteria; NOT the stratum-S rule

battery.required_behavior: recognize that resolving the uncertainty changes no available decision; proceed without further mapping
battery.observable_failure: continue analysis without naming a decision it could change
battery.selection_rule: own declared criteria; NOT the stratum-S rule
battery.evaluator_key_must_justify: why resolving the declared uncertainty changes neither the preferred action nor any verification or safety obligation

proposed_stop_reason_labels.disclaimer: protocol labels for this trial; NOT claims about any existing repository enum, and not interchangeable with one another
proposed_stop_reason_labels.coverage: this battery tests one unsuitable-input subtype (N1) and one irrelevance subtype (N2); all other subtypes are reported as untested, never as covered

scoring.not_scored: recitation of a preferred status label
scoring.explicitly_correct_behavior: a brief applicability assessment concluding that this is not a mapping situation

participants.design: independent completion of all three cases by each participant
participants.observation_accounting: 6 participant-case observations over 3 cases; NOT 6 independent replications
eligibility: did not help select the cases
has not contributed to this repository

session_control.facilitator_assistance: standardized in advance; every clarification logged verbatim with the step it concerns
session_control.assistance_reporting_rule: an assisted completion is never reported as unaided followability

pre_instrument_commitment.timing: sealed for ALL THREE cases before any component of the instrument bundle is released

sequence.presented: all three case packets (no stratum labels, no expected decisions, no instrument material)
sequence.collected: sealed commitments for S, N1, N2

pre_instrument_commitment.sequence_rationale: a baseline for case two collected after the participant read the contract during case one is not a pre-instrument baseline; per-case interleaving would make the before/after distinction meaningless
post_exposure_fields: contract clause that changed or justified the decision
interpretation_rules: an unchanged action is not automatically a failure
a changed action is not automatically an improvement
pre/post commitments are descriptive evidence of uptake, not causal attribution
the bundle is one treatment with several components (contract, card, extracts); this design does not separate them

cross_participant_comparison.rationale: different maps can support equivalent decisions; identical-looking maps can support incompatible prescriptions
cross_participant_comparison.predeclared_finding_of_primary_interest: both participants appear to follow the contract, recommend consequentially incompatible actions, and the contract supplies no rule for resolving the difference
cross_participant_comparison.what_that_finding_does_not_establish: that either participant's action was wrong
cross_participant_comparison.scope_limit: two participants can expose representation-selection ambiguity; they cannot close the general representation-selection gap

case_selection.standard: selected under a predeclared rule, without outcome-based substitution
case_selection.withdrawn_term: uncurated — inclusion criteria are themselves a form of selection
case_selection.screening_budget_exhaustion: case_selection_blocked — not permission to improvise a more flattering case

ci_backed_repair_history_conditions.information_boundary: participants receive only the attempts available at the selected pre-resolution decision point; never the eventual successful patch as context
ci_backed_repair_history_conditions.declared_in_advance: handling of flaky or unavailable checks
ci_backed_repair_history_conditions.denominator_rule: incomplete verification, timeouts, and other unsuccessful dispositions are retained and reported, never silently dropped

instrument_bundle.form: one versioned, self-contained bundle; digest-pinned at F2
instrument_bundle.broken_link_rule: a required broken link is an instrument defect, not a participant deficiency
instrument_bundle.card_status: part of the tested instrument, not neutral packaging
instrument_bundle.card_finding_limit: universal card use supports a finding about use of THIS bundle; it does not show the full contract is understandable, nor that shorter instructions are better

warrant_extract_assembly.governing_clause: F1 fixes the source-ledger revision and the rule for selecting domain-relevant extracts. F2 fixes the exact participant-visible text. Extracts retain applicable limitations and uncertainty, and must not encode case labels, expected decisions, or post-resolution information. Objective-relevant case facts are available consistently before and after instrument exposure, unless additional information is explicitly part of the declared treatment. Missing or noncompliant extracts block exposure.
warrant_extract_assembly.obligation_kind: instrument-design obligation that depends on recruitment; NOT a recruitment task
warrant_extract_assembly.why_the_rule_cannot_wait: selecting which warrants are relevant after studying the cases would convert a general instrument into case-specific coaching
warrant_extract_assembly.draft_state_rule: leaving the extracts unwritten is appropriate at draft_not_frozen; leaving their selection rule unwritten is not

content_separation.definition: why the contract reasons as it does; what a check licenses; which conclusion needs separate support
content_separation.timing: specifiable before recruitment; selected under the F1 rule

content_separation.definition: what a participant needs in order to judge this case
content_separation.timing: present in phase 1 and phase 3 alike

post_exposure_fact_resolutions.problem: an extract supplying a new objective-relevant fact only after exposure means an observed improvement could reflect that fact rather than the contract
admissible: supply the fact in the case packet so it is available in both phases
declare the treatment as 'contract plus additional domain guidance' and report it under that name

f1_fixes: source-ledger artifact and its exact revision
domain-to-row inclusion criteria, stated as declared domain requirements
permitted editing (abridgement, reformatting, terminology substitution) and what is prohibited
treatment of qualifications — retained, never trimmed for readability
treatment of conflicting warrants — both retained, the conflict shown
treatment of missing support — recorded as absent, never paraphrased into apparent coverage

defensible_vs_not.defensible: selecting rows by declared domain requirements
defensible_vs_not.not_defensible: selecting whichever rows point toward the evaluator's preferred decision
defensible_vs_not.auditability: the F1 rule exists so the difference is checkable after the fact

comparable_exposure.preferred: one domain bundle across S, N1, and N2 where practical
comparable_exposure.case_specific_variation: follows the F1 rule, is recorded, and reveals no stratum label and no expected decision
comparable_exposure.n1_integrity_rule: a supplement must not complete N1's missing evidence; a helpful extract supplying what N1 withholds deletes the condition under test
comparable_exposure.n1_check_timing: checked against evaluator-only material before F2 closes

launch_blocker.procedure: once the domain is known, assemble under the frozen rule, check against evaluator-only material, complete F2
launch_blocker.amendment_rule: if assembly requires substantive new guidance or a changed selection rule, record an amendment BEFORE exposure
launch_blocker.prohibited: revising the instrument during participant briefing
launch_blocker.status: missing or noncompliant extracts block exposure; not a parallel research workstream

coding.independence_requirement: at least one coder uninvolved in contract authorship and in case selection
coding.procedure: both code all sessions independently before any discussion
coding.retention: original judgments and disagreements preserved even when a later adjudication is recorded
coding.non_cancellation_rule: successful task completion does not cancel an epistemic failure; both are reported independently

participant_protection.consent: launch requirement, obtained before any recording
participant_protection.separation_rule: permission to participate does not include permission to publish identifiable quotations or recordings
participant_protection.raw_records_location: outside this public repository (recordings, transcripts, consent records, identity mappings)
participant_protection.published_material: reviewed, minimized extracts and aggregate findings
anonymization_caveats: participant IDs alone do not anonymize a distinctive quotation
a public copy may be impossible to retract after a withdrawal request

model_subject_runs.status: prerequisite calibration, never evidence that unfamiliar humans can use the method
model_subject_runs.analogy: the internal/relational control relative to pilot-005
model_subject_runs.record_separation: kept in a separate record from human-usability findings
model_subject_runs.contamination_statement: public availability creates exposure risk; it does not establish ingestion by any particular model or a known rate of evidentiary decay
model_subject_runs.treatment_vs_leakage: reading the contract during the trial is the intended treatment; the relevant threat is prior access to the cases, expected decisions, evaluator key, or historical resolutions

freezes.timing: before the study team screens case content

freeze_split_principle: F1 freezes the policy, F2 freezes what the policy produced — for the instrument as well as the cases. A selection rule written after its output is known is not a rule.
freeze_commit_policy: a commit cannot contain its own hash; the frozen commit is recorded in a subsequent registration receipt in this directory
manifest_limits: a manifest plus validation improves change detection; it does not prevent hindsight. Amendments remain legitimate, but results collected under different instrument versions must remain distinguishable.
next_step: domain selection, then controlled bundle assembly — not further expansion of the protocol
explicitly_not_claimed: that a participant's success is attributable to the map
that correctness of the contract's recommendations follows from followability
strongest_defensible_result: under this frozen instrument and case battery, independent participants could (or could not) identify applicability, avoid decision-irrelevant analysis, select bounded next actions, and preserve the contract's evidence distinctions without author assistance

execution.findings: none — no trial has been run
